name: Field Manual
description: Low-ink grayscale with navy headings. Prints cleanly on office printers and photocopies without losing contrast.

guidance.typography: Headings are bold condensed Arial in navy (#001E2E). Body text is Arial in black. Prefer plain sentence-case headings.
guidance.illustration: Grayscale line illustration: black strokes on white with at most two flat gray tones. No color, no gradients, no shading texture, no text inside the image. Plain white background. Must photocopy cleanly.
guidance.diagram: Grayscale diagram. White nodes with black outlines; navy fill only for the most important node; black connectors. Short sentence-case labels.
guidance.caption: Small Arial caption in dark gray.
guidance.border: Thin gray border with square corners.
guidance.icon: Simple line icons only when they clarify meaning.
